title: Runtime telemetry parsers
content: Runtime telemetry parsers Telemetry parsing is evidence-only metadata enrichment for remote probes. It does not change routing defaults or auto-route by default. Parsers: parseOllamaTelemetry parseVllmTelemetry parseLlamaCppTelemetry parseNimTelemetry parseGenericRuntimeTelemetry Rules: Missing fields are returned as partial or unavailable. Unknown values are kept unknown (not fabricated). No background polling. Unavailable telemetry is acceptable
summary: Telemetry parsing is evidence-only metadata enrichment for remote probes. It does not change routing defaults or auto-route by default.
